title: P2 /chat agent status observability
scope: Add grouped /chat list rows and a bottom short status line. Do not add a workflow-centric panel or new primary status command.
confirmedDecisions: /chat object is the agent/pool chat, not workflow itself
Group chat entries by scope: Workflow, Pool, Standalone
Agent state applies to both workflow stage agents and normal pool agents
Do not expand workflow/stage path in default row; use secondary detail only
No full panel for P2 MVP
No separate status command as primary UX
Fallback is recommended on failed/dead/timeout but not automatic
Status derivation and formatting must be TUI-decoupled for future Tauri reuse
